results.title: Advanced Proxy Calibration Techniques
results.content: The accuracy and precision of proxy calibration directly impact our understanding of past environmental conditions, climate variability, and geochemical processes. In recent years, significant advances have been made in proxy calibration techniques, driven by innovations in laboratory instrumentation, field-based methods, and statistical approaches. Novel Laboratory-Based Calibration Techniques Laboratory-based calibration techniques are essential for establishing the relationship between isotopic proxies and environmental variables. Recent advances in laboratory instrumentation and protocols have improved the accuracy and precision of proxy calibration. ### New Methods for Calibrating Isotopic Proxies Several new methods have been developed for calibrating isotopic proxies, including: * **Multi-proxy calibration**: This approach involves calibrating multiple isotopic proxies simultaneously, allowing for a more comprehensive understanding of the relationships between proxies and environmental variables. Recent advances in field-based calibration methods have improved the robustness and reliability of proxy calibration. Recent advances in statistical techniques have improved the accuracy and precision of proxy calibration. The following equation illustrates the Bayesian inference approach to proxy calibration: Applications of Advanced Proxy Calibration Advanced proxy calibration techniques have a wide range of applications in stable isotope geochemistry, including: ### Reconstructing High-Resolution Climate Records Advanced proxy calibration enables the reconstruction of high-resolution climate records, providing insights into past climate variability and change. ### Improving Isotopic Data Interpretation and Modeling Advanced proxy calibration improves the interpretation and modeling of isotopic data, enabling: * **More accurate data interpretation**: Calibrated proxies provide more accurate information about past environmental conditions. Some of the key future directions include: ### Emerging Trends and Innovations in Proxy Calibration Several emerging trends and innovations are expected to shape the future of proxy calibration, including: * **New isotopic proxies**: New isotopic proxies are being developed, providing new insights into past environmental conditions. ### Future Research Directions and Opportunities Several research directions and opportunities are available in the field of proxy calibration, including: * **Improving calibration accuracy and precision**: Further research is needed to improve the accuracy and precision of proxy calibration. Proxy calibration is the process of establishing a relationship between an isotopic proxy and an environmental variable. Proxy calibration is essential for interpreting isotopic data and reconstructing past environmental conditions.

results.title: A Review of Validation and Calibration Methods for Health Care Modeling and Simulation - Modeling and Simulation in the Context of Health Technology Assessment: Review of Existing Guidance, Future Research Needs, and Validity Assessment - NCBI Bookshelf
results.content: # Chapter 4A Review of Validation and Calibration Methods for Health Care Modeling and Simulation. Our systematic review of evidence- and consensus-based guidance on the conduct and reporting of modeling and simulation studies (Chapter 1) identified model calibration and validation as a major methodological research area. There is limited previous work surveying calibration and validation methods used for health care models and most existing reviews have either focused on a limited topic area (e.g., treatment of cardiovascular disease, cancer natural history) or modeling methodology (e.g., micro-simulation models). Instead, we relied on a mixed approach that combined consultation with expert methodologists; hand-searching the reference lists of related papers, technical reports, and books; review of our personal reference collections; and a systematic review of studies comparing validation and calibration methods for disease modeling-related or health care-related models. The systematic component of our literature review covered four electronic databases (MEDLINE, Cochrane Methodology Register, Health Technology Assessment Database, NHS Economic Evaluation Database), through June 3, 2013, for articles presenting validation and calibration methods in reports of modeling and simulation studies. Two general types of methods are in common use for internal, external, and prospective or predictive validation: ‘informal’ methods using graphical and tabular presentations of model results (e.g., time series and scatter plots, cumulative frequency distributions) and ‘formal’ (statistical) using a distance function or goodness-of fit metric.132 The value of graphical and tabular data displays cannot be overemphasized. Our search for studies comparing alternative calibration methods for health care models identified four relevant studies (Table 7). Several systematic methodological appraisals of health care models and simulations provide information on the validation and calibration methods used in practice. In addition to Rutter (2009),185 other examples of using Bayesian methods for model calibration, validation, and parameter estimation exist, both for health care and non-health care models and simulations. Rockville (MD): Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (US); 2017 Jan. Chapter 4, A Review of Validation and Calibration Methods for Health Care Modeling and Simulation. A Review of Validation and Calibration Methods for Health Care Modeling and Simulation - Modeling and Simulation in the Context of Health Technology Assessment: Review of Existing Guidance, Future Research Needs, and Validity Assessment.
